COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
C482 No. 169 of 2024
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Nalin Saun, learned counsel for
the applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Susheel Kumar, learned counsel
for the complainant.
4. Present C482 application has been
moved along with compounding
application which is supported with the
affidavit of the applicant and respondent
no. 2.
5. Applicant- Dhruv Sah and
respondent no. 2 Riya Panwar are
present in the Court and are identified by
their respective counsel.
6. The present applicant is facing trial
for the offences punishable under Section
366A, 376(3) IPC and under Section
5(l)/6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court
of Addl. District Judge/Special Judge
(POCSO) Dehradun.
7. A supplementary affidavit has been
filed by the applicant wherein it is
mentioned that applicant married with
victim/respondent no. 2 on 15.03.2024 at
15 Shiv Mandir, Kachhari, Nardev, Shastri
Marg, Dehradun and this marriage is also
registered on 15.03.2024 with the
Registrar Compulsory Registration of
Marriages, Dehradun. Photographs of
marriage and copy of Marriage certificate
is also enclosed with the supplementary

affidavit.
9. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief
Holder for the State submits that the
allegations are serious in nature and at
the time of the incident victim was minor
but now she became major. The learned
counsel for the State further submits that
since applicant married with respondent
no. 2 and the parents of the applicant
happily accepted this marriage, if this
proceeding is permitted to continue it will
spoil the life of the applicant who married
with the victim/respondent no.2
10. After hearing the submissions as
advanced by the learned counsel for the
parties as well as learned State Counsel,
the compounding application deserves to
be allowed.
11. Accordingly, the compounding
application is allowed. The proceedings of
SST No. 43 of 2023, State vs. Dhruv Sah,
arising out of FIR No. 44 of 2023,
pending in the court of learned
FTC/Special Judge POCSO,/ADJ Dehradun
is quashed.
11. Since the proceedings are quashed,
the present applicant who was granted
short term bail for the purpose of
solemnizing the marriage by order dated
12.03.2024 in BA2 No. 24 of 2024, copy
of which is also enclosed along with the
supplementary affidavit, on completion of
such period the applicant be released
forthwith.
12. Accordingly, the present C482
application stands disposed of.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 22.03.2024 Parul
